outputs.explanation: This is a spatial transcriptomics tissue image with cluster annotations overlaid (a micrograph-type image), not a plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.
H&E histology images with manual region annotations; these are micrographs, not plots showing averaged/aggregated data.

The spatial expression maps are heatmap-style overlays of per-spot expression on tissue images, which is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement (heatmaps do not need individual point overlays).
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays since these would make the plot unreadable.

This bar graph shows log2 fold-change values per gene derived from differential expression analysis (Seurat FindMarkers, Wilcoxon rank-sum test) across thousands of spatial spots per condition. Each bar represents a single computed statistic (fold change with associated p-value) rather than a mean of a small number of biological replicates, so overlaying individual data points is not applicable/feasible here.
